definitions.explanation: Acting or moving in a quick, lively, and efficient manner. Suggests sharp, decisive movements.

examples.japanese: きびきび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
きびきび⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: She handles work with quick, efficient movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きびきび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: The new employee is working energetically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧きびきび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよく→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: If you act briskly from the morning, the day starts off pleasantly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧きびきび⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: She is always brisk and energetic, and has a positive influence on those around her.

notes:
きびきび is an onomatopoeic adverb describing quick, energetic, and efficient actions or movements. It has a positive connotation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- きびきび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb: to do ~ briskly
- きびきび⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ + noun: brisk, efficient ~
- きびきび⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: to move briskly
- きびきび⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work energetically

EXAMPLES:
- きびきび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧: brisk, efficient movements
- きびきび⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: quick, efficient response
- きびきび⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to give instructions crisply

CONTRAST (antonyms):
- ⟦だらだら→だらだら：05843_daradara⟧: sluggishly, lazily
- ⟦ぐずぐず→ぐずぐず：05844_guzuguzu⟧: slowly, indecisively
- ⟦のろのろ→のろのろ：05162_noronoro⟧: slowly, sluggishly

SIMILAR (positive movement):
- ⟦てきぱき→てきぱき：05649_tekipaki⟧: efficiently, briskly (similar meaning)
- ⟦しゃきしゃき→しゃきしゃき：05943_shakishaki⟧: crisply, briskly

USAGE:
Commonly used to praise employees, service staff, or anyone who works/moves efficiently.
